tldr: Aquarius rising: independent, observant, and built slightly outside the expected pattern.
body: With Aquarius rising, you meet life through perspective, originality, and an instinct for the collective field. Your path asks you to stay true to your difference without using detachment as a wall.
approach: Sees systems clearly, questions stale norms, and brings future-minded clarity into the room.
shadow: Distance, contrarianism, or acting above need when belonging still matters.
note: Authored from Marie Satori Big Three and sign material.
